name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: Central sector scheme providing income support of Rs. 6,000 per year to all landholding farmer families across the country.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: Rs. 6,000 per year transferred directly into bank accounts in three equal 4-monthly installments.

name: Ayushman Bharat - PM-JAY
description: World's largest government-funded health assurance scheme providing comprehensive secondary and tertiary inpatient care.
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefits: Cashless health cover up to Rs. 5,00,000 per eligible family per year across empaneled public and private hospitals.

name: National Scholarship Scheme (Post-Matric)
description: Financial assistance for meritorious and needy students belonging to economically disadvantaged backgrounds for post-matriculation studies.
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: Full college tuition fee reimbursement plus monthly living and book allowances.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)
description: Comprehensive mission to provide housing for all by assisting in constructing pucca houses with basic amenities.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefits: Interest subsidy up to Rs. 2.67 lakh on home loans or direct construction grants for low income families.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Government-backed guaranteed pension scheme aimed at unorganized sector workers.
benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 after attaining 60 years of age.

name: KALIA Scheme (Krushak Assistance for Livelihood)
description: State assistance scheme by Odisha Government to accelerate agricultural prosperity and alleviate poverty for farmers.
ministry: Department of Agriculture & Farmers' Empowerment, Govt of Odisha
benefits: Financial assistance of Rs. 10,000 per family for cultivation along with interest-free crop loans.
